title: The Island That Stopped Growing
desc: Real GDP nearly tripled between 1998 and 2020, then fell every year but one since. A VAT-revenue windfall and a run of promoted sectors, each substituting for the last, explain how much of that growth was ever going to last.

title: Brief: Powering Mann
desc: The power station has about seven years left. The cable to England has about nine. Build your own energy mix (solar, batteries, two cables, and wind if it's consented) and see whether it survives Corrie on a cold, still January night.

title: Keep the Island at 50 Hz
desc: Run the control room for a winter's day, then learn how the Island's grid actually works: the cable and its reactors, N-1 security, the merit order, heat pumps on the teatime peak, and a Manx home in 2030.

title: Noble's Hospital: why more beds won't fix it
desc: 55 patients medically fit to leave — but stuck. Clinicians know what happens when a patient is constipated. The Gent Review (June 2026) shows Noble's has the same problem. The back door is the issue, not the front.

title: House prices vs. wages
desc: The IoM median earner faces a house price 9.1x annual earnings — above the UK's already-stretched 8.2x and more than double the international threshold of 4x.

title: My Budget — build your own Sankey
desc: Enter your income and actual costs. See a live flow diagram of where your money goes. Share it with your MHK. Nothing stored — data never leaves your device.

title: Economic performance
desc: GDP and GVA per head, real growth rates, and output relative to the UK — 2000 to present. Why the headline figures mislead and what they actually measure in a financial centre.

title: Population ageing
desc: Census data plus cohort-shift projections to 2040. Dependency ratios, population pyramids, and what different migration scenarios look like for all three islands.

title: Where government money goes
desc: Department-level Sankey of IoM income and expenditure, FY2016-2025. Animate across years, filter by department, toggle constant prices. All from published Treasury accounts.

title: Manx Care benchmarked
desc: Manx Care's 2024-25 performance against Health & Care Jersey, Guernsey HSC, NHS Wales, and NHS England. Financial, clinical, operational, off-island. Gaps flagged, not suppressed.

title: Noble's Hospital simulation
desc: Discrete-event simulation of bed capacity, occupancy, and throughput at Nobles — admission patterns, length-of-stay distributions, discharge bottlenecks.
